rubric.statement: An `LM` created with `"openai/gpt-4o-mini"` is inferred to use `OpenAIProvider`.
An `LM` created with an `"ft:..."` model such as `"ft:job-123"` is also inferred to use `OpenAIProvider`.
An `LM` created with `"azure/gpt-4o-mini"` and no explicit `provider=` falls back to the base `Provider`, not `OpenAIProvider`.
Passing `provider=OpenAIProvider()` when constructing `dspy.LM("azure/gpt-4o-mini", ...)` overrides provider inference, so that LM uses `OpenAIProvider`.

Calling `finetune(train_data=[], train_data_format=None)` on the default `azure/...` LM raises a `ValueError`, and the program should assert that the message includes the guidance to explicitly set `provider`.
